item.title: UMD SGA plans to eliminate residential representatives
item.description: Currently, this university’s Student Government Association includes executive positions, residential legislators and academic legislators.

item.title: Maryland lawmakers consider banning law enforcement officers from wearing face coverings
item.description: The policy would apply to any law enforcement operating in the state, including agencies from Maryland, another state or the federal government.

item.title: The Clarice’s ‘Macbeth’ is a new twist on classic Shakespeare
item.description: The performance conveys a newfound nuance to the original Shakespearean classic while still maintaining its fundamental tragic roots.

item.title: Being on Maryland men’s lacrosse’s scout team isn’t flashy. But it’s vital to success.
item.description: The Terps' scout team studies opponents' film and helps prepare starters for games each week.

item.title: Love Is Blind season finale is entertaining, but predictable
item.description: As an avid watcher of the show, Wednesday’s finale was good, but nothing special.

item.title: UMD students dance the night away at Bridgerton-inspired ball
item.description: The University of Maryland's SEE hosted its third-annual Bridgerton ball, featuring a privy garden theme.

item.title: Maryland gymnastics prepares for postseason amid injuries, accelerated schedule
item.description: If the Terps advance past the first round, they will have back-to-back meets without a rest day in between.

item.title: Solomon Washington’s tenacity, grit lead Maryland men’s basketball’s rebounding effort
item.description: Despite being just 6-foot-7, Washington has grabbed the sixth-most boards a game among Division I players his height or shorter.

item.title: UMD students voice frustration with Veo overcrowding at campus bike racks
item.description: The university has a cap of 400 Veo e-scooters and e-bicycles on campus, according to a statement from Veo.
